result.summary: Speeds up functional test execution by converting `p2p_lock` to a `threading.Condition` to wake `wait_until_helper_internal` immediately upon P2P message delivery or connection state changes instead of polling every 50ms. In addition, sets `noban_tx_relay = True` across six wallet tests to bypass transaction relay rate-limiting delays between test nodes.
result.problem: Functional tests spend avoidable time idling due to a fixed 50ms polling interval when waiting for P2P events, and several wallet tests run slowly because nodes wait on Poisson transaction relay timers without peer whitelisting.
evidence: Author's benchmarks on an x86-64 machine: 'Wall time (-j=18): 110.8s to 99.1s (-11%)' and 'Accumulated: 1715s to 1411s (-17.5%)'
Author's breakdown of individual test runtimes showing large improvements, such as feature_maxuploadtarget (57.9s to 6.2s) and wallet_conflicts (49.2s to 7.0s)
result.changed_since_previous: Added noban_tx_relay = True to three more wallet tests (wallet_change_address.py, wallet_exported_watchonly.py, and wallet_signer.py), expanding the optimization from three to six wallet tests.
result.card: Speeds up functional test runs by converting p2p_lock into a threading.Condition that immediately wakes wait_until_helper_internal upon P2P message delivery or connection state transitions instead of polling every 50ms. Additionally enables noban_tx_relay across six wallet tests to bypass transaction relay rate-limiting delays. The author measures an 11% drop in overall wall time (-j=18) and a 17.5% drop in accumulated runtime, with several individual tests running up to 85% to 90% faster.

risk.why: Touches only test framework synchronization and test configurations; a defect could cause test hangs or flakiness.
